title: Reliable Meta Image Descriptions · v0.10.4
changes: DESCRIBE retries transient Meta vision 5xx errors with bounded backoff; explicit long Retry-After is shown rather than waiting a minute inside XR.
Meta provider error codes, request ID, status and number of attempts are returned safely; request bodies, API keys and private images are never logged.
When Meta is temporarily unavailable, the image description bubble offers RETRY without leaving XR or losing the selected image.
No silent alternate-model fallback, automatic image generation, new quotas or watcher modifications.
